chatgptPrompt:
Create a YouTube Shorts / TikTok cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Keep the focal point and the text inside the centre safe area: clear of the bottom 25%% and of the right-hand button column.
Subject: a glowing Earth whose surface is dotted with tiny teal tree lights, and, small in the lower-centre foreground, a row of tiny stick-figure people looking up at it with a thin cloud of tree dots floating above them (an illustration).
Composition: Earth in the upper centre, the people in a row below it, a lot of empty indigo night; everything inside the centre safe area.
Lighting and treatment: Earth lit from the left, teal glow (#4FE3C6) on indigo night (#0B0F2A), soft bloom, subtle grain.
Mood: curiosity.
Text: "Guess first." in a clean geometric sans (Lexend style), centred in the lower middle, white.
Scientific accuracy: estimates: the Milky Way holds about 100 to 400 billion stars; Earth is estimated to hold about 3 trillion trees, about 420 per person; both are estimates.
Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news or NASA photo. It must read as a code-rendered illustration in the channel's look.
Style: premium editorial science documentary, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
